# gateway/source-card

- url: https://github.com/gateway/source-card
- owner/name: gateway/source-card
- date checked: 2026-08-15
- verification state: TODO: what was actually verified — e.g. source-only Tier 1/2 read-only triage; list the exact surfaces checked (API metadata, README, LICENSE, manifests, selected source)
- drift risk: TODO: low|medium|high + the evidence (repo age, release velocity, commercial surfaces)
- freshness threshold: TODO: refresh before <install/pilot/payment/config-change events> or after <date>
- current pinned SHA: TODO: default-branch HEAD sha (scripts/source-card-prefetch prints it)
- research depth: TODO: e.g. Tier 2 source-only; GitHub API + raw file reads; no clone, install, run, or auth (or name the deeper steps actually taken)
- source access status: TODO: which public surfaces were reachable without authentication
- execution/pilot status: TODO: NOT installed, NOT run, NOT built, NOT tested, NOT connected; no Trevor keys, tokens, prompts, or data sent (edit if a pilot actually ran)
- primary research reason: TODO: why this repo came up (Trevor pasted URL / starred backlog / X post / comparison chat / dependency of another lookup)
- primary point of view: TODO: the task-specific question this lookup answers for Trevor's current or plausible future projects
- specific conclusion for this lookup: TODO: the direct answer for THIS lookup — what to do, and what not to do yet
- latest source signal: TODO: stars/forks, license, HEAD sha + date, latest release + date, open issue/PR split, advisories (scripts/source-card-prefetch composes this line)
- useful signal: TODO: what the project actually offers that could help Trevor
- useful adoption/adaptation path: TODO: adopt / adapt / watch / wrap / test / process-guard — the constructive path and the alignment work it needs
- transferable patterns: TODO: named patterns worth mining even without adoption
- license/use boundary: TODO: license + commercial/derivative/quoting boundaries that affect reuse
- paid/open-source/build-vs-buy scan: TODO: required when anything is paid/freemium/commercial — existing cards checked, open/self-hosted alternatives, narrow self-build feasibility, buy/pilot/build/skip conclusion; write "not commercial; no paid surface found" when that is the evidence
- security policy / vulnerability reporting: TODO: SECURITY.md present? private reporting path? public advisories count
- credential and secret surfaces: TODO: keys/tokens/OAuth/env/config the tool would touch if used. NEVER write bare 'none' — if none found, write 'none identified in source-only triage; not inspected' or list actual surfaces (e.g. 'GitHub Actions with secrets, API key in config/example.env')
- network/API/webhook/tunnel/browser surface: TODO: endpoints, ports, feeds, third-party services it talks to. NEVER bare 'none' — if none found, write 'none identified in source-only triage; not inspected'
- local file/config mutation surface: TODO: files/dirs it writes or rewrites (watch ~/.claude, ~/.codex, shell rc). NEVER bare 'none' — if none found, write 'none identified in source-only triage; not inspected'
- sensitive data classes: TODO: prompts/PII/business/customer data it could see if used. NEVER bare 'none' — if none found, write 'none identified in source-only triage; not inspected'
- install/run blast radius: TODO: high|medium|low per use mode (source-mine vs local pilot vs live adoption) + why
- risk signal: TODO: evidence-backed risks only; say "no evidence of malicious code in inspected surfaces" plus the concrete boundaries
- disposition: TODO: one of — adopt-as-pattern: <specifics> | pilot-scoped: <specifics> | skip-with-evidence: <specifics> | watch-until: <specifics>
- next action: TODO: the single next step if Trevor wants more
- refresh priority: TODO: high|medium|low + what triggers a refresh
- adoption-mining priority: TODO: high|medium|low + for which pattern(s)
- downstream learning targets: TODO: BARE TOKENS ONLY — comma-separated repo slugs such as hermes,website-creation, or none: <specific reason>. NO parentheticals, NO em-dash justifications — the validator rejects them
- Hermes relevance: TODO: BARE TOKEN ONLY — direct | adjacent | upgrade-candidate | none: <specific reason>. NO period, NO justification after the token — the validator rejects 'adjacent — reason' or 'adjacent. reason'
- by: TODO: actor (model + session/thread id)
